agents.sharedFolder: Shares this folder with {{agents}}, so the same skills show up there too.
agents.alsoReads: Also loads skills from {{folders}}. A skill in two of these folders may load twice.

overview.emptyDescription: No agent was found on this computer, or all of them are switched off. Turn agents on or add your own in Settings.

switchedOff.title: Switched off
switchedOff.hint: Installed, but they receive no skills until switched on in Settings.
switchedOff.others: Agents not found on this computer are listed in Settings.

workspace.emptyTitle: This folder has no skills yet
workspace.emptyDescription: Add skills from the library and they will be installed for {{agent}}.
workspace.addDescription: Pick library skills to install in this agent's global skills folder.

plugins.title: From plugins
plugins.description: {{agent}}'s plugins bring these skills. Its plugin manager owns them, so they are shown here only; turn plugins on or off with /plugin in {{agent}}.
plugins.twiceHint: A skill with this name is also in {{agent}}'s skills folder, so {{agent}} loads it twice.

broken.title_one: {{count}} folder here is not a skill
broken.description: {{agent}} skips them: a skill needs a SKILL.md at the top of its folder. Fix the folder, or delete it if it is left over.

reason.danglingLink: Link to {{target}}, which no longer exists

broken.managedHint: {{app}} put this copy here. Deploy the skill again from the library to repair it.

confirm.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
confirm.folderDescription: {{path}} goes to Recently removed in Settings → Storage, where it is kept for {{removedDays}} days.
confirm.linkDescription: Only the link is removed. What it pointed at is already gone.

confirm.uploadDescription: The library copy is overwritten with this folder's contents. Every agent and project that uses the library copy gets the new version.
confirm.pullDescription: The folder in {{agent}} is replaced with the library version. Its own changes go to Recently removed in Settings → Storage for {{removedDays}} days.
confirm.removeDescription: This copy has changes the library does not have. The folder goes to Recently removed in Settings → Storage for {{removedDays}} days. The library copy stays.
confirm.deleteDescription: This skill exists only in this folder. It goes to Recently removed in Settings → Storage for {{removedDays}} days.
confirm.removeManyDescription_one: The folder is removed from this agent. The library copy stays, so you can add it again later.
confirm.removeManyDescription_other: The folders are removed from this agent. The library copies stay, so you can add them again later.
confirm.deleteManyDescription_one: This folder exists only here. It goes to Recently removed in Settings → Storage for {{removedDays}} days.
confirm.deleteManyDescription_other: These folders exist only here. They go to Recently removed in Settings → Storage for {{removedDays}} days.

batch.skippedHint_one: {{count}} selected skill has no batch action
batch.skippedHint_other: {{count}} selected skills have no batch action

toast.nowManaged: {{app}} manages this skill from now on: the folder here is a deployment of the library copy.

errors.upload: Could not upload the skill to the library.
errors.pull: Could not pull the library version.
errors.delete: Could not delete the local skill.
errors.addNone: None of the skills could be added.

wsl.copies: Inside WSL ({{distro}}). Skills are copied here, not linked: Linux cannot follow a link back into Windows. Saving a skill refreshes the copies.
wsl.hint: An agent that runs inside WSL? Use its Linux folder, for example \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\you\.claude\skills.

reload.live: {{agent}} picks up new, changed and removed skills while it runs.
reload.new_session: {{agent}} sees new, changed and removed skills in a new session.
reload.restart: Restart {{agent}} to see new, changed and removed skills.

command.live: If one does not show up, type {{command}}.

reload.ask: In a running session, ask it to “{{ask}}”.
reload.unknown: Its documentation does not say when {{agent}} sees skill changes. If one does not show up, start a new session or restart it.

hint.newSession: Start a new session in {{names}} to see the change.
hint.live_one: {{names}} picks it up while it runs.
hint.live_other: {{names}} pick it up while they run.
hint.unknown_one: If {{names}} does not show the change, start a new session or restart it.
hint.unknown_other: If {{names}} do not show the change, start a new session or restart them.
